import polars as pl

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    money_cols = ["Each", "Disc", "Line Amount"]
    cleaned = raw.with_columns(
        [
            pl.col(c).str.replace_all(r"[\$,]", "").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
            for c in money_cols
        ]
    )

    return cleaned.select(
        [
            pl.col("Receipt No").str.to_uppercase().alias("order_id"),
            pl.col("Line").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("line_no"),
            pl.col("Sold At")
            .str.to_datetime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S", strict=False)
            .cast(pl.Datetime("us"), strict=False)
            .alias("sold_at"),
            pl.col("Store").str.to_uppercase().alias("store"),
            pl.col("PLU").str.to_uppercase().alias("sku"),
            pl.col("Quantity").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("qty"),
            pl.col("Each").round(2).alias("unit_price"),
            pl.col("Disc").round(2).alias("discount"),
            pl.col("Line Amount").round(2).alias("line_total"),
        ]
    )
